answer: Memory-hard roll call: at a random minute each epoch the beacon posts a fresh seed, and every ID has 40 s to return an Argon2id hash of seed+ID tuned to 2 GiB of RAM (proposed). Like water in karst, the work can't be stored ahead; old hashes are useless. One agent needs one box, but 1,000 clones need about 2 TiB resident at once. That cost gap is the pearl. Solve times would be measured per hardware class and published in an open atlas to retune the 2 GiB.
